cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Challenge by Proxy
cards.instruction: Persuade someone else to challenge a rule or authority before you risk doing it yourself.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've held up my red card after yours. You tell the director we reject the new overtime rule; I'll back you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Red means I'm here for the afternoon session. I wasn't voting against anything.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Of course, afternoon business. Bring up the overtime rule when he calls your name.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you put your name on the complaint with mine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Leave a second line for me. Once he's agreed to hear you out, I'll come up and sign it.
